Revid vs VEXI: Auto-Mode Video or Your Whole Social Media?
Revid and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Revid makes and publishes short-form video on autopilot [1][2]. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your business's whole feed.

Revid's home page headline reads “Where short-form creators grow”: it writes, renders, publishes, and learns from your results [1]. It turns a prompt, script, link, product page, audio file or PDF into an editable video, with the script, voiceover, visuals and subtitles made in one workflow [1]. Its Auto-Mode keeps a repeatable content plan moving, and every plan publishes directly to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X [1][2]. On its pricing page today, Growth is $39 a month, or $32 a month billed yearly, with 2,000 AI credits and 3 Auto-Mode workers; Ultra is $199 a month, or $166 a month billed yearly, with 12,000 credits and 10 workers [2].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Revid already publishes on its own, today [1][2]. The difference is what goes out. Revid makes videos from prompts, links and other inputs, built for growing short-form channels [1]. VEXI makes your feed: your own clips edited with B-roll, music and captions, designed posts and carousels, captions and long-form video, all from one conversation about your business. VEXI costs more than Revid: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.

Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Revid's plans come with Auto-Mode workers, 3 on Growth and 10 on Ultra, that keep a content plan moving [1][2].

One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.

Yes: Revid's pricing page says every plan includes direct publishing to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X, and Auto-Mode workers [2]. Its home page describes a test channel where, every night, Revid's autopilot wrote the script, made the video and published it [1]. Can Revid edit my own videos?

Revid turns a prompt, script, link, product page, audio file or PDF into an editable video, and you can refine the result in its editor [1]. VEXI edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.
